description: 🌳 Tiny & elegant JavaScript HTTP client based on the Fetch API

latest_release.body:
> [!NOTE]
> In `init` hooks, `options.headers` now has lowercase names. Read and delete headers with lowercase names, for example `delete options.headers.authorization`.

### Improvements

- Add [`maxResponseSize`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/ky#maxresponsesize) option  0d59458
	- Limits the response body size in bytes, counted after decompression. Exceeding it throws the new [`ResponseSizeError`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/ky#responsesizeerror).
- Let [`beforeRetry`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/ky#hooksbeforeretry) hooks change options for the next attempts (#885)  242c327
	- Return `{options: {...}}` to change `onUploadProgress`, `onDownloadProgress`, `timeout`, `fetch`, or `throwHttpErrors`. For example, retry a failed upload without upload progress.
- Respect `Retry-After` and rate-limit headers when [`retry.shouldRetry`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/ky#retry) returns `true`  d1c921f
- Run `beforeError` hooks for errors thrown while reading the response body  323b98f 50c3810
	- A connection that drops while `.json()`, `.text()`, etc. reads the body is now a `NetworkError`.
- Support `onUploadProgress` and streamed `Request` bodies in Bun and Deno  83c711c
- Validate options and report clear errors  3ded2aa
	- Invalid options now throw a `TypeError` that names the option, instead of being silently ignored or failing later with an internal error. This includes `null`, non-array hooks, and invalid `timeout` and `retry` values.
	- Invalid options and errors thrown by `init` hooks now reject the returned promise instead of throwing synchronously.
- Improve TypeScript types  51b3177 52b8f93 f4886ca 481f6f7
	- Accept readonly arrays and explicit `undefined` for all options, allow custom error names, and fix the `.clone()` and `.bytes()` return types.

### Fixes

- Fix aborts and timeouts in many edge cases  e1b088e 2f0a3fb 7c1272b 82fa84c 3f0e330
	- User aborts and timeouts now also cancel requests returned from hooks, interrupt pending hooks and body reads, and are no longer reported as `NetworkError` and retried in Chromium. `totalTimeout` is now enforced when the response or body arrives after the deadline.
- Fix `searchParams` with a `Request` input dropping its body and options such as `credentials`  b4bdecc 4e0bf0b
- Fix option merging in `.extend()` and `init` hooks  e06d351 0655b9d c5dc4e6 88e2432
	- Class instances, such as an undici `Agent` as `dispatcher` or a `Date` in `json`, are no longer turned into plain objects. Header names are now matched case-insensitively. Changes made in `.extend()` callbacks and `init` hooks no longer leak into other requests.
- Fix many `replaceOption()` edge cases  cc9b5a3 d6e049a deb5a33
- Fix `parseJson` being ignored by `response.clone().json()` and when using `onDownloadProgress`  c6c5dbf 015ef95
- Fix progress events, including wrong `totalBytes` for compressed responses and missing response properties with `onDownloadProgress`  d89c8c8 e893f16 de278ae
- Fix `onUploadProgress` breaking uploads without request stream support, and `keepalive` and `no-cors` requests  6520f64 06ebf18
- Fix `fetch: window.fetch` throwing "Illegal invocation" in browsers  92ef60e
- Fix `isTimeoutError()` and the other type guards matching unrelated errors with the same `name`  d636438
- Fix `request` on Ky errors being an internal clone instead of the request that was sent  619c427 ec3d17f

---

https://github.com/sindresorhus/ky/compare/v2.1.0...v2.2.0
